subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw keep pursuing this PR's probe-based exit-0 behavior after the shipped systemd exit-78 fix, or close/narrow it as superseded?
rationale: The main user-facing systemd restart-loop symptom is already handled in v2026.6.11 with a different exit-code contract, while this branch changes gateway startup/auth semantics and has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Confirm exit-78 supersedes this PR
options.body: Close this conflicted branch if the shipped sysexits-78 behavior is the intended fix, and track any remaining non-systemd probe gap in a fresh narrow issue or PR.

options.title: Sponsor a rebased probe repair
options.body: Ask for a refresh that keeps only the remaining healthy-probe gap, fixes trusted-proxy source validation and IPv6 URLs, removes unrelated churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept exit-0 probe semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose the exit-0 probe design despite compatibility, auth-boundary, and availability tradeoffs, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm exit-78 supersedes this PR
recommendation.body: Close this conflicted branch if the shipped sysexits-78 behavior is the intended fix, and track any remaining non-systemd probe gap in a fresh narrow issue or PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the shipped systemd exit-78 fix discussion that determines whether this branch is superseded or should be narrowed.
